name: av_live_cheap_final
source:
{ Live accessor, cheap: the ODE input reaches the analytic system through the
  tie kk = kmin + dk, so `dk` is a real analytic unknown and the second-solve
  pass integrates once per Newton iterate. }
Tinf = 20
Temp0 = 95
kmin = 0.01
kk = kmin + dk

FinalValue('Temp') = 60

DYNAMIC cooling (method = ode45, time = 0 .. 1, points = 3)
  der(Temp) = -kk*(Temp - Tinf)
  Temp(0) = Temp0
END
